notes.title: "Cat's Meow Live Wallpaper" - The Cats' Grand Adventure is Just Around the Corne
notes.content:
The release date for Cat's Meow Live Wallpaper is finally here!

On September 15th at 8 AM (JST) (September 14th at 11 PM (UTC)), the cats will come to your desktop.

This "meow-meow" adventure is bound to bring a fresh charm to your everyday life. Get ready to enjoy fantastic moments spent with these furry companions! Exciting encounters, surprises, and fun await beyond this wallpaper. Your desktop is about to transform into a new realm of adventure, making every day special with these feline friends.

Get ready for the release of Cat's Meow Live Wallpaper!
